notes.title: Moon VR is on SALE!!
notes.content:
Dear Community,
We are the team behind Moon VR Player. It was a popular VR video player back in the day. Sadly, in 2017 we ran out of seed funding and later suspended development. However, we decided to keep a loose team with voluntary work, as most of us still believe in virtual reality and the technological evangelism that comes with it. Thankfully, the hard times are over! We are now back as a team with abundant funding!

As part of our comeback, we have made it 60% OFF, as a way to say thanks to the entire VR community for your support.

Feel free to download Moon VR Player on Steam and try it out!

If you like Moon VR, please leave a review in the store! It makes a big difference for us.
If you have any issues, suggestions, or just want to chat, feel free to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ScjQ6Jx3qm]Discord[/url].

Thanks for your support, and we aim to make Moon VR the best video player for years to come!

notes.title: Important Notice[2023.3.20]
notes.content:
To make sure your controller works properly, please [b]update your SteamVR to version 1.25.6[/b]!
Also, you need to update MoonVR player to the [b]latest version[/b]!
The update will fix the bug that appeared before that the controller does not work properly.
Thank you very much for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Important Notice
notes.content: Due to the latest SteamVR update, controllers may not be well recognized. If your controller is not recognized, please press "F" on your keyboard to use Head Tracking, or you can rollback to the "Legacy" version of Moon Player . Developers are fixing the issue now, and thanks for your patience and support.

notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230314
notes.content: Change the grip action of the valve index controller to trigger, and make it can use the trigger when griping.

notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230203
notes.content: Increase the grip threshold for the valve index controller, which is used to lower the possibility of the invalid trigger when griping; Valve Index users may need to relax other fingers while pressing the trigger to avoid triggering the grip.

notes.title: 3.0.0-feature-20230128
notes.content: - Added a button in the top left of the screen and hot key "F" on the keyboard to quickly turn the head control mode on and off.

notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230106
notes.content: - Fixed the bug which may not set the decoding API properly on the settings page (DirectShow, MediaFoundation, or Auto)

notes.title: Moon VR Update: External Subtitles and DLAN Supported!
notes.content:
Dear all,
Moon VR is constantly working to improve your experience with us.
Here is what’s new in our latest version on Steam:

[b][Features]
[list]
[*] Brand new UI and UX, easier and simpler to use!
[*] Brand new homepage environment
[*] More kinds of 3D video and screen mode supported: Youtube, Fisheye and so on
[*] Better screen grabbing and adjustment function
[*] Better subtitle function
[*] DLNA supported!
[*] Automatic recognition of video playback mode based on file name
[/list][/b]

We do look forward to your feedback!
Feel free to join us on Discord, or send your suggestions or issues to support@moonvrplayer.com
Thank you for your support!
Moon VR
p.s. Just in case you still wish to install the older version, please find [legacy-legacy channel] in [BETAS].

notes.title: Play video encountered black screen how to do?
notes.content:
If you find the video playback process, the screen black screen situation. Please do the following:

Into the Steam library, right-click Moon VR Video Player - local files - browse the local folder - select Extra there are two exe files, install any one.
